text_block_list.text:
When I showed up at the training grounds, I happened upon Victoire Pisa
talking with another horsegirl.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh my!
You're inviting me to run alongside you?

Standing beside Victoire Pisa is... Rose Kingdom.
Apparently hailing from the prestigious "Rose Clan," she's one of the top contenders among her peers.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To reach the heights I aspire to, a worthy rival at my side is essential.
This challenge—I would have you accept it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: The conditions—Turf, 2,400m, simulating the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course, I would be glad to.
Besides, I'm looking forward to running with you, Rose-san.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You have my thanks. Furthermore... other formidable runners are set to join us.
For instance—

When frontrunners for the upcoming Classic campaign gather, I have no reason to refuse.
Merely spectating such a supreme matchup would be... unrefined, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my! Ruler-san, hello.
It's been three days since we last met on the track.

She is Rulership. An intellectual horsegirl who graduated from the same
training academy as Air Groove, known famously as "The Empress."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, to enjoy a race at its finest, peerless tactical research is indispensable.
Even away from the running track, the board is constantly in motion.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I heard today's joint run gathers top-class talent ideal for testing strategies.
Why miss the chance to see if my move can decisively conquer the board?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Your strategies always manage to surprise us, Ruler-san.
I'm looking forward to seeing how it unfolds.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
And there is one more prominent contender.
...Her.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Could it be Flash-san?
Heh, this couldn't be a more perfect matchup.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Yes, however—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I must first complete my scheduled routine.
As I informed Rose-san, we will begin at 16:12 sharp."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —or so she stated.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Specifying down to the exact minute as always, I see. But... heh, not bad.
Advancing things strictly according to one's calculations... is essential for victory.

Eishin Flash. She is another strong prospect for the upcoming Classic campaign.
Her calm demeanor never misses a split-second opening, pairing flawlessly with her razor-sharp late burst.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Pisa-san. I have been keeping a close eye on your running for some time now.
Today, I will give you everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I'll do my absolute best not to let anyone down! ♪

Surrounded by so many colorful personalities, a thought suddenly
crossed my mind regarding Victoire Pisa. Namely—
choice_data_list: What is she running for, exactly...?

text_block_list.text:
"To become a king my family can be proud of." "To dominate the turf like a chessboard."
Like her rivals, most runners have clear, defined goals, but—
choice_data_list: It feels like she's driven by something completely different.

text_block_list.text:
Part of it might just be her soft, airy demeanor, but it felt
as if she harbored something distinct from mere ambition.

Yet, that doesn't mean she's passive or lagging behind
the other girls in any way. Far from it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Drei... zwei... eins— Now, here I come...!
Haaaaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Heheh... ♪

text_block_list.name: Rose & Ruler
text_block_list.text: What...?! / N-No way...!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well played...! And here I thought
I had timed my surge to absolute perfection...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, this is far from over...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That was a great match. It gave me a clear idea
of what I need to work on. Let's do this again sometime.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Not enough cards in hand... especially against Pisa, huh?
*sigh*... I fold, I fold. Guess I'll just go sulk in my room...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
You have my thanks. Battling a worthy rival is always instructive.
This joint session held meaning only because you accepted, Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm just glad I could help.
Getting to run with all of you... nothing makes me happier.

—Running clearly brought her immense joy and excitement.
There was no question about that.

Yet, could someone hailed as one of the brightest prospects
of her generation truly blossom this far without a definite goal?

A few days after the joint session,
I ran into Victoire Pisa on the way back from shopping.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Something you wanted to ask me...?
choice_data_list: Yeah. You don't have to answer if it's uncomfortable, but...
Yeah. You don't have to answer if it's uncomfortable, but...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
choice_data_list: What is it you want to accomplish through your running?
What is it you want to accomplish through your running?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...What I want to accomplish...?
Well, let's see. It's just—

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that smoke coming from the alleyway...?
Wait... is there a fire?!
